run_offline_rl_benchmark: run an offline RL benchmark using Implicit Q Learning on a Gym environment like HalfCheetah
evaluate_offline_rl_agent: evaluate an offline RL agent by training on collected data and running evaluation episodes
get_random_agent_returns: get episode returns of a random agent to compute baseline for normalized offline RL scores
create_offline_data: create offline RL training data by collecting transitions from a data collection agent in an environment
calculate_normalized_score: calculate the normalized score comparing offline agent returns against random and data collection agent baselines
